title: AskEvent
description: One line of the NDJSON stream that POST /api/ask returns. A live crew answers a viewer's question about a moment: the client shows each step in the control-room strip, then plays the overlay. Order: step/tool/verdict events in any order, then one overlay (or one refusal), then done. error may replace anything after the first line.

text.description: step: what the agent is doing, one short line for the strip. refusal/error: the reason shown to the viewer.

overlay.description: type=overlay: the answer, same contract as a show chapter (surface 'player'). Its script carries audio and word cues.

audio_url.description: type=overlay: where the client fetches the answer audio, if not played through Voice Live.

cached.description: type=done: true when the whole answer came from the cache.

trace_id.description: type=done: the Foundry trace id for this run.

summary.description: Result in one line, e.g. 'gap 6.4 m between lines'.

Sketch.description: The tool's own geometry, drawn at once while the crew is still thinking; the overlay replaces it.

match_tc.description: The moment the geometry is drawn on.

claim.description: The claim as the Pundit said it.

reason.description: Why it was rejected, e.g. 'tool says 6.4 m, not 8 m'.

round.description: Rewrite round; 1 is the first draft.

proposal.description: The Tactician's change, e.g. 'left back holds 4 m deeper'.

accepted.description: The Critic accepts only if the tools show the change helps.

net.description: Metrics that got better minus those that got worse, from the moved team's view (what_if's value).

tool_call.description: Id of the tool call that measured 'after'.
